We spent the summer in Oslo with our three senior toy dogs: a Chihuahua, a Toy Poodle, and a special-needs Pomeranian. Both the Poodle and Pom are deaf, so our trio—while very sweet—needs a little extra attention to feel safe and comfortable. They were also in serious need of some spa time after six weeks of travel.

Juliet was able to fit all three in at the same time on short notice. We were a little nervous leaving them with someone new, but Juliet was so kind and made sure they were the only dogs in the salon. No crates, just gates to keep them safe from wandering. When we returned a couple of hours later, everyone looked spiffy, clean, and—most importantly—very happy. It was clear they had been treated with care and weren't stressed at all.  The Pomeranian (a specialty of Juliet’s) was trimmed beautifully and looked so much better than the scraggly pup who walked in.

Juliet is warm, kind, gentle, and clearly has a special connection with her canine clients. We will definitely be back next summer and booking regular spa days for our little ones.
